clips.title: The story
paras: Lakeridge Highway is an old thoroughfare running along the southern shore of Lake Everstill in the Redridge Mountains. Once a vital and heavily traveled artery prior to the First War, it has fallen into ruin and disuse. Today, roving packs of gnolls and Blackrock orcs make passage along the road perilous for travelers.

Before the devastation of the First War, the Lakeridge Highway served as a bustling trade corridor through Redridge, carrying goods and folk along the southern banks of Lake Everstill. In those peaceful days, travelers could journey between the valley settlements and the eastern heights under the protection of the Kingdom of Stormwind. That safety shattered when the Horde marched through the region, leaving eastern Redridge contested and desolate.

Following the seizure of Stonewatch Keep by Blackrock orcs, regular maintenance and patrols along the highway ceased entirely. The road quickly deteriorated into an overgrown track contested by savage gnoll packs. With Stormwind's military spread thin and unable to reinforce Lakeshire, the highway remains officially unsafe. Any traveler seeking to reach the eastern ridges must now carve a path through gnoll ambushes.
